source.title: J4: repeat J1's audit once U146 is on main: observe Request on a real Daemon
source.body:
<!-- work-order:scenarios/journey.md:J4 -->
## Outcome
repeat J1's audit once U146 is on main: observe Request and the Review of its result, specify the next uncovered behavior

## Acceptance
Scenarios: J4
Specification: [scenarios/journey.md](https://github.com/saadshahd/roundup/blob/main/scenarios/journey.md)

## Scope
`.agents/data/journey.md` for evidence; `scenarios/**` only for the selected gap; GitHub Issues; evidence under `artifacts/ux/journey/`

## Preserve
existing scenario acceptance; no product code

## Dependencies
https://github.com/saadshahd/roundup/issues/469

## Queue
Key: J4
Priority: 8
Mode: specify

goals.statement: On a main that holds U146, the J4 audit drives the Request stage through `just harness-real` on a real `rupd`: a Message sent by pointer to a started Room's Door is acted on and its result (a Todo or outcome) shows in the App. The main SHA, commands and artifact paths or run links go under `artifacts/ux/journey/` and `.agents/data/journey.md`.
goals.observer: Independent review compares the cited harness-real output and the 1280x800 and 700x800 captures under `artifacts/ux/journey/` with the Request acceptance in `.agents/data/journey.md` on the cited main SHA.

goals.statement: The same audit observes the Review of that Request's result on the real Daemon at both journey viewports, or records Review as unproved and names the exact missing implementation or observer.
goals.observer: Independent review checks the cited Review evidence, or the stated gap, against `.agents/data/journey.md`. A test name, declared RPC or seeded screenshot does not count.

goals.statement: Following J1's policy, the audit specifies at most one bounded next uncovered behavior: a scenario in its owning file, plus one implementation work Issue with correct native blocked-by dependencies. It reuses existing owners such as U113 and U145 (#440) and leaves exactly one waiting successor audit with the next J id. If all five stages are proved on one main, it leaves no successor.
goals.observer: `loop/rules.sh ready` prints the new implementation Issue's correct ready, waiting or in-flight state, and prints the successor audit as waiting. Independent review checks that no owned work is duplicated.
